statement: Equivalence of local-system infinity categories is detected by maps into the coefficient core and arrow core.
notes: Two test objects do not alone construct a derivator.

statement: For an E-infinity ring R, the derivator of presentable R-linear stable categories realizes W_ModR^lc as its constant-coefficient class.
notes: Specified monoidal enhancement; all small indexing shapes; larger coefficient universes; zero ring included.

statement: The Hom-category constant tests in presentable R-linear categories yield the same class as the ordinary-derivator realization.
notes: Does not assert every HDer axiom for an enriched-shape extension.

statement: The specified second rational categorical stage detects K(Z/p,2) for every prime p and K(Z,2), and is strictly smaller than the first stage.
notes: Uses units in Q(zeta_p), and powers of 2 in Q.

statement: The specified finite-type coefficient tower is W0 superset W1 superset ... with intersection W_infinity.
notes: Does not characterize a canonical raising operation on arbitrary derivators.

statement: The attached Di Vittorio accepted v2 proves HDer1-HDer4 for enriched models and leaves HDer5 as Conjecture3.2.23.
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: Recent results; Part E and G
notes: Shift invariance of all five assumed axioms is proved; enriched shapes differ from ordinary Cat.

statement: Every accessible W_D^lc is realized by the derivator of its localized spaces; this applies to every presentable infinity-category coefficient and is functorial for specified inclusions of localizers.
notes: Uses product stability and Cisinski2006 Theorems4.2.15,1.4.3; unrestricted derivator-morphism functoriality is not asserted.

statement: The full second linear stage consists of component-bijective maps whose based-loop maps are Wlc_ModR; for Hk this is pi1/pi2 isomorphism plus k-homology equivalence of 2-connected covers.
notes: For Q equivalently exact pi0/pi1/pi2 and rational higher homotopy. Uses canonical free-linear-presheaf algebra map and monadicity, including disconnected loops.

statement: Every 2-connected rationally acyclic space is invisible to the specified second rational categorical stage; in particular K(Z/p,3).
notes: Independent Postnikov proof; both coefficient core and arrow core have rational homotopy groups above degree two.

statement: The rational loop tower is realized at all stages by ordinary localized-space coefficient derivators, with strict exact-rational stages and intersection W_infinity; the intersection conclusion extends to every accessible component-detecting initial LC class.
notes: Includes every nonterminal presentable initial coefficient. The first linear coefficient category may be retained; later localized-space coefficients are not asserted to be higher linear categories.

statement: Functorial coefficient raising on all bare derivators and all their morphisms, and realization of the higher rational stages by higher Q-linear categories, remain unresolved.
notes: Full ordinary tower and its intersection are constructed; only higher linear-categorical realization remains separate.

statement: All-set local systems with their designated evaluation functors recover the fundamental groupoid, whereas finite-set Galois theory is profinite.
notes: Yoneda reconstruction; empty and disconnected cases included; CATHOT reflector cited without reproof.

statement: Enhanced R-linear local systems with a coherent evaluation functor reconstruct R[Omega X] as an E1 algebra and reconstruct the many-object linear path category.
notes: Recover the specified algebra via the evaluation monad, not only a Morita class.

statement: The enhanced infinity-topos of space-valued local systems has shape X; designated enhanced fiber functors recover X; the homotopy category plus specified constant functor recovers X in Hot.
notes: Known shape construction, independently proved; constant functor is additional named datum in ordinary formulation.

statement: For a locally connected Grothendieck topos, locally constant sets are split representations of its fundamental pro-groupoid; the classifying topos is their filtered-colimit completion.
notes: Hoyois Thm3.13 and Cor3.20; retains covering-family data; no unsupported claim LC always a topos.

statement: Kaledin Cor6.1.2.5 reconstructs spaces from enhanced groupoid families; Thm7.3.1.3 is the general enhanced-category representability theorem.
notes: Exact Pos and Pos+ shapes and uncountable regular size bounds retained; Chapters6-7 preliminary.

statement: Raising coefficients and varying shapes are different reconstruction procedures; Pi1 Map(BJ,X) cannot be replaced by Map(BJ,Pi1X).
notes: Finite tetrahedral face poset and K(Z,2) witness; exact program output attached.

statement: The recognition condition W_C^lc=W_infinity is reflection of specified map equivalences by the local-system functor; the computed positive and negative cases are listed.
notes: General rings and E-local spectra inherit qualifications from Part C.

statement: The literal bare ordinary category plus ordinary fibers is not proved here to reconstruct loop-chain E1 algebras, or spaces without additional structure.
notes: Exact gap is recovery of coherent monad data; not presented as a counterexample.
